therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Abiraterone Acetate + Enzalutamide (combination arm) vs Abiraterone Acetate alone
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CYP17A1 inhibition (abiraterone) and androgen receptor antagonism (enzalutamide)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Androgen deprivation and androgen receptor signaling blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Prostate cancer patients undergoing neoadjuvant therapy before prostatectomy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Proportion of participants with pathologic stage ≤ypT2N0

results.effect_size: Group A (combination): 13 participants with ≤ypT2N0, Group B (abiraterone alone): 11 participants with ≤ypT2N0
results.dose_information: Abiraterone 1000 mg daily, Enzalutamide 160 mg daily, Prednisone 5 mg daily, LHRHa monthly or 3-monthly injection for maximum 7 months
